title: Mercury Knitwear workers’ salary-arrears road blockade
reason: Excluded: the article describes an exclusively private employer dispute over three months of salary arrears at Mercury Knitwear and reports no demand to government or public policy.
notes: The Daily Observer reports about 400 workers blocked the Dhaka–Chattogram highway at Kanchpur, Sonargaon. The public-road location and approximate crowd size do not convert the named company’s arrears dispute into a state-directed demand; company management promised payment within one to two days.
